query:
WITH me AS (SELECT created_at, id FROM v2_job WHERE id = $3),
        waiting AS (
            SELECT q.id, q.scheduled_for, q.worker IS NOT NULL AS requeued, j.created_at
            FROM concurrency_key ck
                JOIN v2_job_queue q ON q.id = ck.job_id
                JOIN v2_job j ON j.id = ck.job_id
            WHERE ck.key = $1 AND ck.ended_at IS NULL AND ck.job_id <> $3
                AND q.running = false AND q.canceled_by IS NULL
        ),
        slot AS (
            SELECT GREATEST(
                $2,
                (SELECT MAX(w.scheduled_for) + INTERVAL '1 millisecond' FROM waiting w, me
                    WHERE w.requeued AND (w.created_at, w.id) < (me.created_at, me.id))
            ) AS s
        ),
        younger AS (
            SELECT w.id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY w.created_at, w.id) AS rn
            FROM waiting w, me, slot
            WHERE (w.created_at, w.id) > (me.created_at, me.id) AND w.scheduled_for <= slot.s
            ORDER BY w.created_at, w.id
            LIMIT 100
        ),
        pushed AS (
            UPDATE v2_job_queue q
            SET scheduled_for = slot.s + younger.rn * INTERVAL '1 millisecond'
            FROM younger, slot
            WHERE q.id = younger.id
        )
        SELECT s AS "s!" FROM slot
